title: Publish or Perish
logline: A journalist hires a pilot to recover their stolen investigative thesis on measuring station decay, only to find the thief is a bounty hunter who wants to sell it to the highest bidder.

roles.description: Desperate to publish their life's work before someone buries it.
A pragmatic mercenary who realizes information is worth more than blood.
A heavily modified interceptor designed for capturing high-value targets.
A massive media conglomerate that controls all local news feeds.
Automated data intake arrays for the local news feeds.

public_situation: The {role:investigative_journalist} claims their groundbreaking thesis on catastrophic station decay was stolen right before publication.
private_truth: The bounty hunter stole it on behalf of a corrupt station manager, but realized the data is so explosive they can auction it off to the highest bidder.

beats.public_change: The bounty hunter puts out anonymous feelers for an auction of 'sensitive structural data'.

missions.reason: The journalist needs the pilot to scan the hunter's ship to confirm the encrypted thesis is on board.
missions.private_fact: The journalist is broke and has no way to actually buy the thesis back.

beats.public_change: The publishing house catches wind of the auction and threatens to sue anyone who buys it.

missions.reason: The journalist pays the pilot to disable the hunter's ship and recover the drive from its cargo pod.
missions.private_fact: The bounty hunter is expecting an ambush and has heavily armed their ship.

beats.public_change: The pilot has the drive, but the publishing house makes a massive counter-offer to bury the story.

missions.reason: The journalist begs the pilot to deliver the raw data directly to the publishing house's automated upload servers to force publication.
missions.private_fact: The ambitious journalist promised credit to the original research assistants but plans to file the breakthrough under their name alone.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces the upload of the data.
resolutions.summary: The thesis proves half the sector's stations are structurally failing. Panic ensues, but repairs begin. The journalist becomes a legend.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot leaked the structural decay data that caused a system-wide panic over failing stations.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the bribe and deletes the thesis.
resolutions.summary: The publishing house buries the story. The pilot gets rich, the journalist's career is ruined, and the stations quietly continue to decay.
The bounty hunter sells the thesis to corrupt station managers who bury it. The journalist is never heard from again.

loose_threads.detail: The bounty hunter's comm logs show the steal order came from the insurer that underwrites half the sector's stations.
The journalist notes that the structural decay patterns perfectly match deliberate micro-fractures caused by sonic weapons, not age.

radio_hooks: {role:investigative_journalist} claims massive cover-up regarding station safety.

voice_direction.investigative_journalist: Fast, paranoid, constantly looking over their shoulder.
voice_direction.ruthless_bounty_hunter: Cold, professional, treats everything as a transaction.
